column1: # Custom partition table for the 16MB-flash T-SIM7670G-S3.
# No OTA needed (explicit non-goal for this PoC) so a single factory app
# partition is used. "spiffs" is kept as the subtype/label name because
# Arduino-ESP32's LittleFS.begin() looks up a partition by that label by
# default -- it is mounted as LittleFS regardless of the label name.
